name: whatsapp
title: WhatsApp
description: Your WhatsApp chats in the panel through a self-hosted OpenWA gateway: recent chats with the unread ones first, full-text search over your whole history, and your contacts. Reading is always on; sending and reacting only if you turn it on.
author: pal

settings.label: OpenWA URL
settings.description: Where the OpenWA gateway answers (its /api is under it). The owner's runs at http://wp.lan; a generic install is http://localhost:3000.

settings.label: API key
settings.description: A key from OpenWA's Settings, API keys, sent as x-api-key. Kept in the OS keychain; the file holds a reference.

settings.label: Session
settings.description: The OpenWA session's name (the UUID it resolves to is cached); the one your phone is linked to.

settings.label: Send
settings.text: Send messages, reply and react from pal
settings.description: Off (the default) leaves WhatsApp read and mark-read only: no message field, no reply, no reaction, whatever the key could do. On adds Send a message (the text typed in the bar, or a form) and React to a chat row and the reply field to the bar popover; nothing is sent without your text.

settings.label: Open chats in
settings.description: auto opens the desktop app when it is installed (macOS) and the web client otherwise. A group has no link of its own, so it opens WhatsApp at the top either way.

options.title: The desktop app when installed, else the web client

chats.title: Chats
chats.description: Every chat, unread first then newest first, with the picture, the newest message and who sent it, the unread count, the time; the pane is the last twenty messages as a conversation.

store.tagline: Your WhatsApp chats, search and contacts in the panel
features: Chats newest first, unread on top, with the latest message, who sent it and the unread count
`enter` opens the chat in WhatsApp, `cmd+enter` marks it read; the side pane shows the last twenty messages
Full-text search across your whole archive, with who said it, where and when
Contacts with their numbers: open a chat, copy the number or a vCard
A bar item counting unread chats, hidden at zero and red while a direct chat waits; `space` in its popover reads a chat, `i` ignores it until the next message without the blue ticks
Sending, replying and reacting stay off until you turn them on; your chats go only to your own gateway

actions.title: Open chat
actions.description: In the desktop app (whatsapp://send?phone=) or the web client; a group opens WhatsApp at the top.

actions.title: Mark as read
actions.description: Mark as unread on a read chat; works on marked rows too.

actions.title: Send a message
actions.description: The text typed in the bar (the row's argument), a Reply choice quoting the latest message; a form when picked without it; send on only.

actions.title: React to the latest message
actions.description: One of WhatsApp's six quick reactions, or remove yours; send on only.

actions.title: Open WhatsApp settings
actions.description: On a hint row: the extension's settings.
